messages:
maria_marketing: Quick sync 4dd Targeting announcement for Optimize v1.3 on Tue 10:00 PT. Need final changelog bullets, canonical docs URLs, and canary timing to lock blog + webinar.

noah_eng: On it. Draft changelog incoming by EOD tomorrow. Proposal: staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%).

maria_marketing: Staged is preferred. Suggest 5% for 2h, 25% for 4h, full at +24h. That minimizes demo risk.

noah_eng: Sounds good. We'll add auto-fallback to compact model variant and rollback rules (95th latency + error-rate thresholds).

priya_docs: I can create /docs/release/optimize-1-3 and /docs/guides/quantization. Need final bullets and an anonymized rollout YAML snippet.

noah_eng: WIP changelog bullets:
- Improved batching heuristics to reduce short-prompt tail latency
- Fix: prefix KV cache invalidation for multi-tenant pools
- New q4_legacy quant profile: ~20% memory reduction with small quality delta
- Canary routing + automatic fallback to compact variant

sam_product: Add a short explainer for q4_legacy: recommended for low-latency chat & high-concurrency inference; include suggested eval prompts.

lena_design: I'll make hero art and social tiles. Copy constraint: avoid exact latency numbers.

maria_marketing: Agreed 44d Use relative language: "~20% memory reduction" and "15-25% fewer tail spikes in internal chat benchmarks." Link to internal deck.

noah_eng: Deployment plan: start canary 10:00 PT, health checks on 15m windows. Auto-rollback if 95th >15% vs baseline or error rate >0.5%. release-bot will post stage updates.

release-bot: Canary scheduled: 1789993000 (10:00 PT). Will ping at each stage.

priya_docs: ETA docs live: tomorrow 12:00 PT. I'll post URLs here when ready.

maria_marketing: Timeline recap: EOD tomorrow  final changelog. Tomorrow 12:00 PT  docs live. Mon AM  design assets. Tue 10:00 PT  announce + canary. Wed  webinar invite to opt-ins.

noah_eng: Confirmed. I'll include rollback thresholds in the changelog appendix and note customer opt-out for pinned model versions.

maria_marketing: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, flag here ASAP. :thumbsup:
